component.name: Mailficient
component.summary: A focused, native desktop email client

description.p: Mailficient provides a refined adaptive interface, secure message reading, rich composing, tasks, calendar invitation handling, advanced search and automation, and offline-friendly account synchronization.
Restores explicit Minimize and Maximize controls in the custom main-window toolbar on desktops whose decoration preferences expose only Close.
Prevents crashes while selecting messages during mail checks and bounds HTML-reader memory with lazy conversation loading, capped inline content, released WebKit documents, and renderer recovery.
Releases obsolete mailbox models, recycled rows, reader actions, and full message bodies while eliminating multi-second stalls when switching between populated and empty favorites.

Adds Apple-style drag-and-drop toolbar customization and arbitrary whole-app colors across system, light, and dark appearances, while fixing adaptive styling, toolbar stalls, retained memory, and delayed SQLite saves.
Adds complete provider-backed folder workflows and a dedicated advanced Rules window, while refining the toolbar, sidebar, preferences, account setup, adaptive layouts, and light and dark appearance.

Makes Send own a reliable isolated SMTP attempt, moves optional Undo Send to a bottom-window action, fixes deleted conversation members and stale unread indicators, and keeps cross-process Outbox status current.
Removes the 500-message ceiling, continues large initial imports through bounded background sessions, and keeps the Inbox stable while streamed mail updates arrive.
Moves Safe Senders, Blocked Senders, and remote-image sender management into a separate searchable window with compact summaries in Safety preferences.

Improves mail-check speed, task navigation, draft cancellation, folder state updates, HTML rendering, Safe Sender handling, file dialogs, spell checking, and overall interface polish while fixing several memory-safety and selection issues.

Adds durable Undo Send and compose safeguards, Today and Planned tasks, calendar RSVP and meeting workflows, message identity warnings and safe unsubscribe review, advanced rules and Quick Steps, and bounded server-side search.
Opening a message directly now clears and persists its unread state consistently.
Fix unread indicators, mailbox unread counts, and read-action labels.
Improves favorite switching and updates move and copy destinations immediately.
Improved responsive toolbar spacing and fixed compact-toolbar hover rendering.
Improved toolbar consistency, enabled GNOME Contacts in address-book builds, and refreshed release packaging.
Letter-based mail commands now require Ctrl, so search and other text fields accept normal typing.
Unread badges now update immediately when messages are opened, and deleting a message reliably selects the next message after the removal is applied.
